title: Life cycles: plants and animals
subject: science
strengths: Most of the class can name the stages of the plant and butterfly life cycles in order.
The class can explain that new seeds forming inside a flower start the plant cycle again.

modelAnswers.question: What three things does a seed need to wake up and sprout?
A caterpillar has formed its pupa. What is happening inside the pupa, and what will come out?
modelAnswers.answer: Its body is changing inside the pupa, and an adult butterfly will come out.

commonErrors.misconception: The flower is the end of the life of the plant.
commonErrors.example: A learner writes on the worksheet that the flower is the last part to appear, so the plant's life is finished.

fixIt.prompt: Fix it: say what is forming inside the flower, and what those things do next.
fixIt.corrected: Corrected working: new seeds are forming inside the flower; they fall to the soil and sprout, starting the cycle again.

commonErrors.misconception: The flower is the end of the life of the plant.
commonErrors.example: On the exit ticket, a learner says the flower ends the plant's life because nothing comes after it.

fixIt.prompt: Fix it: say why the forming seeds show the flower is not the finish.
fixIt.corrected: Corrected check: the flower is not the end - inside it new seeds are forming, and the cycle starts again.

nextSteps: Reteach the trap, landing that the flower is not the end: inside the flower new seeds are forming, and the cycle starts again.
Practise following one seed round the whole cycle - seed, seedling, adult plant, flower, new seeds - before answering cycle questions.
